== Spelling cite fixed (20 October 2026) ==
The old cite for the "J.W. Miller" spelling was the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2007-decklists/ 2007 Decklists] page. Its [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013152327/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2007-decklists.html archived copy] does not show his name in any spelling, so I removed that cite. I then checked the 2007 Worlds Day 2 PDF: the player name on both of his deck sheets (pages 69 and 70) is handwritten ''J.W. Millet''. The lead now cites those pages. ''J.W. Miller'' is listed as a variant because it is the spelling in his three 2007 Worlds deck page titles; none of the deck sheets gives that spelling. The page name stays JW Millet. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 02:09, 21 October 2026 (UTC)

== Deck pages and sheet images renamed (20 October 2026) ==
The 2007 Worlds Team sheet (page 19) also reads ''J.W. Millet'', like the Day 2 sheets. I moved the three 2007 deck pages from "J.W. Miller" to "JW Millet" titles and the three sheet images from "Miller" to "Millet", with redirects kept, and updated the links on [[2007 World Championship]] and the deck pages. The lead no longer lists ''J.W. Miller'' as a variant, because none of the sheets or other cited pages uses it.
